title: Plugin Manifest v1
description: Plugin Subsystem v1 manifest vocabulary (MANIFEST.yaml). FROZEN surface per .agents/shared/planning/plugin-subsystem/v1-interface-contracts.md §2. Unknown fields are refused by construction (additionalProperties: false at every level). Division of labor: THIS SCHEMA expresses vocabulary SHAPE (types, enums, allowed keys); policy checks whose refusal codes are semantically demanded by the validation matrix (kebab name, alarm_owner presence, parity section presence, divergence-entry well-formedness, fence completeness, tag-only pins) live in daemon/plugin_subsystem/manifest_reader.py and deliberately carry no structural constraint here, so the dedicated code always wins over a generic structural code.

schema_version.description: SemVer. Plugin #1 authors against the literal "1.0.0". 1.0.x = additive only; the validator accepts the 1.0.x family and refuses anything else until the runner carries the newer schema.

name.description: kebab-case; MUST match the plugin directory name (semantic checks name_invalid / name_dir_mismatch in manifest_reader).

license.description: SPDX id; validated exact-match against plugins-convention/spdx_ids.json (semantic code license_invalid; validator list is EVOLVABLE, field carry FROZEN).

tag_pin_per_class.description: TAG-ONLY pins per provenance class (semantic code non_tag_pin refuses SHAs/empties; full branch-vs-tag discrimination is vendoring-time, slice 3). snapshot_with_drift_alarm absent => inherit copy_freely pin. own_outright is never synced, so it carries no pin.

integration_path.description: "A" only with a complete fence_grant block (semantic code fence_missing).

execution_mode.description: POSITIVE declaration; absent => REFUSE (silence is not permission). Enforced semantically with refusal code absent_execution_mode, hence deliberately not in the schema-level required set.

lifted_symbol.description: B-path field (required iff execution_mode=lifted-symbol; row required_manifest_fields, semantic code missing_required_manifest_fields).

entrypoint.description: B-path field; relative path rooted under adapter/ (semantic code entrypoint_invalid). <=200-line tripwire numeric CI lands with the first real plugin trees (slice 2).

runtime_pin.description: Exact version pin; ranges refused (semantic code runtime_pin_not_exact, strict peer-dep).

ipc_schema_pin.description: Semver pin of the IPC schema.

fence_grant.description: FROZEN block; required iff integration_path=A. Field-level absence is semantic code missing_required_manifest_fields (row required set); block completeness (non-empty rationale/granted_by/granted_at) is semantic code fence_missing — deliberately no schema-level required/minLength so the dedicated codes win.

copy_freely.description: Clean-pulled upstream data; never authored locally. alarm_owner REQUIRED (semantic code alarm_owner_missing; empty/missing both refuse) — deliberately not schema-required so the dedicated code wins.

paths.description: Globs relative to the plugin tree root.

alarm_owner.description: Role-or-team that owns this class's drift alarms.

escalation.description: EVOLVABLE placeholder; v1 default semantics: block-promote-after-days with N=14.

snapshot_with_drift_alarm.description: Hot upstream content snapshotted with drift alarms + reconcile. Non-empty paths REQUIRE a non-empty, well-formed divergence_register (semantic codes empty_divergence_register / divergence_entry_malformed) — deliberately not schema-required. The optional `upstream_paths` field (additive per CON §8 1.0.x rule) is the parallel mapping: paths[i] is the LOCAL subtree, upstream_paths[i] is the corresponding UPSTREAM subtree. When absent, the sync-runner falls back to the strip-class-prefix heuristic (matches the copy_freely layout where local and upstream share the trailing path).

upstream_paths.description: Optional additive field (CON §8 1.0.x): parallel to paths. paths[i] is the LOCAL subtree; upstream_paths[i] is the corresponding UPSTREAM subtree. Same length as paths. Required when the local class subtree is renamed relative to the upstream tree (e.g. the snapshot class renames apps/daemon/src/prompts/ → prompts/daemon/ for the local audit layout).

items.description: Numbered, exhaustive. Required fields {id, files, delta, rationale, pinning_test} enforced semantically (divergence_entry_malformed); upstream_ref is the one optional field per the CON §2 vocabulary.

own_outright.description: Ensemble-authored, never synced, invisible to the sync-runner. Deliberately carries NO alarm_owner (authored locally — there is nothing upstream to alarm on) and NO divergence_register; declaring either here is a vocabulary refusal by construction.

parity_boundary.description: REQUIRED SECTION (semantic code missing_parity_boundary — deliberately not schema-required so the dedicated code wins). Subsections are lists that may be empty; any row present must carry non-empty {path, reason} (semantic code parity_row_malformed).
